_comment: Kinetic Leisure - Event Templates (tokenized + variance). Phase 2: expanded healthy baseline for ITSI-ready data.
_description: Identity tokens (hydrated at startup from stores.json): __NWID__, __S3__, __S6__, __SN__, __CC__, __cc__, __CITY__, __IPO__, __MAC__. Variance tokens (replaced at send time with random values): %%JITTER%% (2-8), %%LATENCY%% (10-25), %%VQOE%% (7-10), %%TX_OCT%% (2M-6M), %%RX_OCT%% (1.5M-4.5M), %%TX_PKT%% (15K-35K), %%RX_PKT%% (10K-25K), %%RESP_MS%% (30-65), %%HOP_LAT%% (4-12), %%ISP_LAT%% (3-9), %%RSSI_GOOD%% (-45 to -55), %%RSSI_OK%% (-60 to -68), %%POE_USED%% (120-280), %%UPTIME%% (86400-604800), %%REACH_PCT%% (99.5-100.0), %%PATH_CHG%% (0-2), %%LOSS_ZERO%% (0.0-0.3).
_mutex_note: Faults in the same mutex group should not run simultaneously - they write conflicting events to the same sourcetypes/devices. ise_policy_rejection and camera_wifi_flap are independent and can coexist with any other fault.

_device_map.S001 (MS-1): Uplinks AP-1 and AP-2. PoE-powers IoT cameras, scanners on ports 1-12.
_device_map.S002 (MS-2): Uplinks AP-3. PoE-powers POS terminals, sensors on ports 1-8.
_device_map.AP-1: Main floor front. Clients: IoT-Camera-01, scanner_svc_01, POS-Terminal-01.
_device_map.AP-2: Main floor rear. Clients: IoT-Camera-02, scanner_svc_02.
_device_map.AP-3: Stockroom/back office. Clients: IoT-Sensor-Temp-01, pos_terminal_01, IoT-Camera-03.
